name: PR detail Overview renders the seeded Why & Risk brief and its review-focus navigation
description: From PR #482, confirm the Why & Risk card (S15/S16) renders the seeded brief on the Overview tab — title, the seeded 'what' statement, and the risk level as a word (AC-27) — then activate its first review-focus entry (src/config.ts:12, matching the seeded finding) and confirm it opens the Files changed tab with the seeded diff line in view (AC-29's navigation half, per BQ-5/A). The card's review-focus entry is a real <button> whose visible path is middle-truncated and aria-hidden, with the full 'path:line — reason' text in a visually-hidden span that forms its accessible name (WhyRiskCard.tsx FocusRow) — so it is targeted by role + accessible name, not by its visible text, mirroring the tab-switch pattern already used in 04/05. The flow never presses generate (no POST /pulls/:id/brief), which is how AC-34 (no LLM call) is satisfied structurally rather than by an environment guard — the seeded pr_brief row (S18) is read as a clean cache hit (out_of_date: false). It then returns to the list and opens the SECOND seeded PR, #613 'Bump pino to 9.4.0', which is seeded with pr_files but deliberately with NO pr_brief row, and asserts the empty state, its hint and the generate control (AC-28) — the generate control is read with `find role button text`, never clicked, because `find`'s default action is click and pressing it would be the one thing that makes a POST /pulls/:id/brief and breaks AC-34. #613 exists because AC-28's given ('a PR with no stored brief') cannot hold on #482, which is seeded WITH one; it is a second PR in the SAME repo, not a second repo, so flow 01's first-repo redirect is untouched, and its title shares no substring with any other flow's text locator. Read-only seeded data. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
